page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 52 dedicated physical cores and 52 vCPUs, indicating a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio with no hyperthreading enabled. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, which translates to approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high compute-to-memory ratio make this instance suitable for workloads requiring sustained CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core environments, though the lack of bundled local storage and GPUs requires external provisioning for storage-heavy or acceleration-dependent tasks.

Given the dedicated 52-core configuration and compute-focused memory ratio, the ecs.c6t.13xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads. Suitable applications include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and scientific modeling that require predictable CPU performance and do not demand high memory-to-core ratios or local NVMe storage.
